/bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\nIgnore:\\n' && cat .gitignore && printf '\\nGit status:\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\nInstalled top-level packages:\\n' && ls node_modules | head -70 && printf '\\nTracked files:\\n' && git ls-files"

/bin/bash -c "git status --short && printf '\\nChange summary:\\n' && git diff --stat && printf '\\nLockfile:\\n' && cat package-lock.json && printf '\\nRuntime:\\n' && node --version && printf '\\nBrowser availability:\\n' && (command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || command -v google-chrome || true) && printf '\\nFile lines:\\n' && wc -l server.js store.js public/index.html public/app.js public/styles.css test/server.test.js README.md"

/bin/bash -c "printf 'API: '; curl --silent --show-error http://127.0.0.1:43187/api/books; printf '\\nHome HTTP: '; curl --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:43187/; printf 'CSS HTTP: '; curl --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}\\n' http://127.0.0.1:43187/styles.css"
